actions.title: List saved database connections
actions.summary: Lists the database connections saved in the SQL panel: id, name, driver, JDBC URL (secrets masked) and user. Never returns passwords.

id.description: Stable id; always unambiguous as a 'connection' argument

name.description: Display name; also accepted as a 'connection' argument

url.description: JDBC URL with any password-like parts replaced by ***

username.description: Login user, or null if the URL carries its own

actions.title: List tables in a database
actions.summary: Lists the tables and views of a saved connection, in one schema or all user schemas, with estimated row counts where the database offers them.

connection.description: Saved connection id or name (see sql.connections.list)

schema.description: Schema to list; omitted means every schema except the database's own system ones

nameLike.description: SQL LIKE pattern the table name must match, e.g. 'order%'

schemas.description: Every schema of the connection, system ones included

estimatedRows.description: The database's own estimate, or null where it has none

truncated.description: Whether the limit cut the list

actions.title: Describe a table
actions.summary: Returns a table's or view's columns (type, nullability, default), primary key, foreign keys and estimated row count; optionally counts its rows exactly.

schema.description: Schema of the table; may be omitted when the database has only one user schema

countRows.description: Also run SELECT COUNT(*); slow on large tables

table.description: The name as the database spells it

type.description: The database's type name, e.g. varchar

size.description: Length or precision, where it applies

primaryKeyPosition.description: 1-based position in the primary key, or null

primaryKey.description: Primary key columns in key order

estimatedRows.description: The database's own estimate, or null

rowCount.description: Exact row count; only when countRows was true

actions.title: Read rows from a table
actions.summary: Reads rows from one table or view, optionally choosing columns, filtering by column equality and sorting. Builds the SELECT itself, so it cannot change anything.

schema.description: Schema of the table; may be omitted when the database has only one user schema

columns.description: Columns to return, in this order; omitted means all

where.description: Column name to value; rows must equal every value (null means IS NULL). For other conditions use sql.query

orderBy.description: Columns to sort by; prefix a name with '-' for descending, e.g. ['-created_at', 'id']

offset.description: Rows to skip first; pair with orderBy for stable pages

rows.description: One list of values per row, in column order

truncated.description: Whether more rows follow; read on with offset + rows returned

actions.title: Run SQL on a database
actions.summary: Runs any SQL - queries, updates, DDL - on a saved connection with auto-commit on, and returns each result set or update count.

sql.description: The SQL to run, in the database's own dialect

maxRows.description: Most rows to return per result set

timeoutSeconds.description: The database stops the statement after this long

results.description: One entry per result, in order: rows for a query, an update count for anything else

rows.description: One list of values per row, in column order

truncated.description: Whether maxRows or the size budget cut the rows

updateCount.description: Rows changed, for a statement that returns no rows
